title: Fynkel project
description: `fynkel.project.json` at the root of a game (blueprint §7, ADR-0006): the startup scene, the input actions, the quality profiles, the component registry and the build targets. One fixed file name; the envelope's `id` identifies the project and `name` is the game's name. Tool and runtime versions live next to it in `fynkel.lock.json`.

startupScene.description: The scene a host loads first; must resolve to a `.scene.json` in the asset database. Without it the project opens with no scene loaded, for a game that builds its world from code (ADR-0026).

assets.description: The asset root, relative to the project directory (`/`-separated, no `..`).

inputActions.description: Named input actions (blueprint §5.1: games use named actions, never hard-coded key checks). A stub until the input contract (M3): the action's type and the bindings that produce it, as `<device>:<control>` strings.

quality.description: Graphics quality profiles a game can switch between at run time (blueprint §15). Distinct from cook profiles, which are per build target.

layers.description: The objects' layers (ADR-0020), one per bit of a mask (bit i = layers[i]): a `fynkel.Layer` names one, colliders' `mask`, cameras' and lights' `culling_mask` and queries name several. Layer 0 is always `default`; `World.layerMask(names)` turns names into a mask.

tags.description: The objects' tags (ADR-0020): a `fynkel.Tags` carries any of them as bit i = tags[i]; `GameObject.hasTag(name)` and `World.findWithTag(name)` look them up by name.

components.description: The component registry: every component type the project's documents may use. Absent means "every built-in type". Native entries must exist in the loaded component schemas; behaviour entries are Dart Behaviours (M2-15) and data entries Dart data asset types (ADR-0027); both declare a type even without its generated schema.

targets.description: Build targets. Platform folders exist only for enabled targets (blueprint §7); `profile` names the cook profile used for that target (`fynkel cook --profile`).

type.description: button: pressed/held/released; axis1d: -1..1; axis2d: a vector in the unit square.

bindings.description: `<device>:<control>`, e.g. keyboard:Space, keyboard:W, mouse:left, gamepad:south, gamepad:leftStick, touch:overlay/jump. Checked by `fynkel validate` (FYN-P0009) with the grammar in docs/input.md: keyboard keys and layouts (WASD, Arrows, IJKL, a/b or l/r/d/u key list), mouse buttons/wheel/delta, gamepad buttons/axes/sticks in GameController naming, touch:overlay/<name>.

default.description: The profile in `profiles` a host starts with.

profile.description: Cook profile name (ASCII letters, digits, '-' and '_').
